assessment_goal: Analyze a provided LCP implementation to identify logical errors in handling empty strings and varying string lengths
misconception_target: Assuming all strings contain at least one character, causing index‑out‑of‑bounds errors

assessment_goal: Evaluate the time‑complexity analysis of an LCP algorithm and locate inefficiencies in nested loop structures
misconception_target: Confusing O(N·M) complexity with O(N) where N is number of strings and M is average length

assessment_goal: Diagnose incorrect handling of special characters that cause premature termination of the common prefix detection
misconception_target: Treating special characters as delimiters and stopping the prefix search too early

assessment_goal: Analyze a vertical scanning implementation to detect off‑by‑one errors in character indexing across strings
misconception_target: Using the length of the first string as loop bound instead of the minimum length of all strings

assessment_goal: Compare the binary‑search based LCP approach with vertical scanning, focusing on correctness of the monotonic predicate used
misconception_target: Assuming the predicate is always true for mid values, leading to an infinite search loop
